findings: Private source_tags retains original single-mask admission: exact one-based source range, fixed full geometry/width and current captured U64 words. Domain is nonserialized and never grants an owner, loan or credit.

Each trichotomy bucket follows only known total scalar predicates/copies and exact same-cell reads from one consistent identity bank. Unknown/fallible work, unknown secondary bounds and unknown branches mark the entire bucket active; they cannot prove identity. One bound per axis is never changed. All-active/nonfactorable tables decline, and different identity bases decline.

The active table must equal the Cartesian product of its row and column projections. A compound domain is emitted only when proper and strictly finer than the old mask, or when it admits a proper domain without an old mask. Equivalent single masks retain the old emitter.

Selection iterates columns outside rows, both in original ascending source-coordinate order, including Ne gaps. The same exact injective mapping feeds evaluation and publication. Count is clipped to admitted fixed extents and checked against the full output count; division occurs only in reached nonempty loops.

Only an independently implied original single-mask edge can be forced. Durbin has no old edge, so its Lt versusEq source branches remain. R retains only its original rowEq edge; columnEq versusGt remains. Independent expected-value tests distinguish these branches and reverse old-vector reads.

Complete scratch capacity, view/owner/epoch/span/disjointness guards, source arithmetic tree, logical fees and source callback counts remain. Same-bank publication reads only overwritten cells; other-bank full publication requires complete initialization before any store. Partial scratch remains raw private generated-code storage, with Frame.next zero rather than a full-output certificate; no canonical Value/host typed slice is formed from holes.

Generic NumericMapFinish still independently rejects next!=count success. Phase callers ignore the internal local frame and publish only after all checked evaluation succeeds; failure replays before publication.

All740 broad and19 focused checks, both features, all30 original/decoded/restored finite C cases and the optimization15 all17002-liveout/exact-counter/Object gate passed. The unknown-branch refinement and all parser/compile/coverage failures are retained before any performance observation.
